sections.title: About these terms
sections.body: These terms describe the Next Episode service, provided by Alexandru Ionut Brulea, based in Romania. For support, complaints or questions, contact {{SUPPORT_EMAIL}}. The app helps you organize shows and movies and record viewing progress. These service terms operate alongside the software license applicable to your platform and do not waive mandatory legal rights.

sections.title: A free personal organizer
sections.body: This version is free to use and includes no advertising, paid subscriptions or in-app purchases. It does not stream movies or episodes and does not provide access to paid viewing services. Your use must comply with applicable law and must not interfere with the app, its providers or the rights of others.

Check the external service before subscribing, renting or buying. Any transaction is with that service under its own terms; Next Episode does not process those payments.

sections.title: Episode reminders
sections.body: Alerts are optional reminders based on available episode information and your chosen offset. Delivery depends on permissions, device scheduling, time settings and updated catalog information. The app cannot guarantee exact delivery or uninterrupted reminders. You can disable alerts in the app or in device settings.

sections.title: Your local library
sections.body: Your library, progress and preferences are stored on your device. There is no publisher-operated account or cloud synchronization service in this version. Removing a title may preserve its watch history and cached information. Deleting app data can permanently remove your records. Backups, where available, are controlled by your device and backup provider; Next Episode does not guarantee recovery.
